info.title: fliks-engine
info.description: fliks video engine: control plane, supervisor

503.description: no `hostCaps` given and hardware detection has not finished (Retry-After: 1)

200.description: one EngineEvent per `data:` line, event name = `type`

400.description: no config set yet, or an invalid ownerId/path

409.description: no running job, or the host cannot pause ffmpeg

codec.description: Source codec, lowercased, whatever it is.

AudioPlan.description: One audio output's decision: a verbatim copy of the source or the encode target.

reasonFlags.description: Why the track is re-encoded (`Audio*` flags); empty when copied.

BurnInSpec.description: A subtitle burnt into the video, already resolved by the host.

filter.description: The libass `-vf` step (`subtitles='...'`) of a text track.

streamIndex.description: Stream index of an image track, overlaid.

live.description: A session or job uses it: never evicted.

CapabilitiesResponse.description: `GET /v1/capabilities`: the summary plus the exact host state the decision reads.

ClientInfo.description: Display facts of the client a session plays on; opaque to the engine.

CodecVariant.description: Output video format: `hdr` is `null` for SDR.

DecideBody.description: Body of `POST /v1/decide`. `hostCaps` overrides the engine's detected capabilities (debug, shadow runs).

contentType.description: Host MIME type of the file, echoed for Direct Play.

audioStreamIndex.description: Position in `info.audio`, not a stream index.

burnInIsText.description: Text (not image) burn-in: only libass forces the pipeline off HW.

burnInSubtitleId.description: Only tested for truthiness: id 0 means no burn-in.

tokenParam.description: Host URL suffix (`?token=...`), copied verbatim into `playUrl`.

transcodeTonemapping.description: Whether a transcoded rung runs a tone-map, whatever the play method.

DeviceProfile.description: Mirrors `DeviceProfileDto`; bitrates and counts are f64 (JS numbers).

hostUrl.description: Resolver callback base URL of the host.

oneOf.description: The rung or hardware a session is served from changed.

waitedMs.description: How long the request waited for the segment to be produced.

EstimateSizesRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/estimate-sizes`. `fileSize` is the source size in bytes, 0 when unknown.

ownerId.description: When given, must be the session's owner (403 otherwise).

sessionLost.description: The sid is unknown: the client re-opens a session.

probeStale.description: The probe blob predates the engine's schema version.

scanMissing.description: No source scan: the remux keyframe grid and audio checks were skipped.

HostCaps.description: What the decision reads of the host: detected backend and boot probe results (`core::hw`).

disabledDecoders.description: Decoder descriptor ids the boot probe blacklisted (`hevc_qsv_decode`, ...).

disabledEncoders.description: Encoder descriptor ids the boot probe blacklisted (`hevc_qsv_main10`, `libx265`, ...).

libfdkAac.description: Not read by `decide` (it picks the AAC encoder binary in the argv builder).

probes.description:
Names of the probes that passed; unlisted ones read false. Known names: `tonemapOpencl`,
`tonemapOpenclCrop`, `tonemapOpenclHdr10`, `qsvOpencl`, `qsvOpenclHdr10`, `vppQsv`,
`vulkan`, `cuda`, `cudaHdr10`, `opencl`, `openclHdr10`, `amfOpencl`.

JobStats.description: The ffmpeg run behind a session ("stats for nerds").

actualHw.description: `none` after a hardware failure fell back to the CPU.

frontierSegment.description: Latest segment written, absent before the first one.

restarts.description: Spawns of this job key after the first (seeks, rung switches, fallbacks).

LifetimeConfig.description:
How long sessions, ffmpeg jobs and cache sweeps live; the cache TTL and budget are in
`StreamingConfig`. Zero is not a duration: `session::LifetimeConfig` keeps the default then.

jobFallbackTimeoutMs.description: Idle window of a job that never had a viewer.

jobGraceMs.description: Delay between the last viewer leaving and the ffmpeg job being killed.

liveSessionTtlMs.description: A session without a heartbeat for this long is dropped (kept revivable).

maxSessionsPerOwner.description: Beyond it the owner's oldest session is evicted, never the new one.

pinnedSessionTtlMs.description: Heartbeat TTL of pinned (download, offline) sessions.

sessionReviveTtlMs.description: How long a dropped session's id can still revive.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped when probing changes what it records; absent on blobs persisted before the engine existed.

timestampBreakSeconds.description: Absent until the background scan ran; `null` when there is no break.

path.description: Absolute path, already authorised by the host.

MuxFlavour.description: Segment container of the HLS output.

OpenSessionRequest.description: `POST /v1/sessions`: decide, open the session and prewarm its job, atomically.

ownerId.description: Opaque owner id (`[A-Za-z0-9_.-]`, 1 to 64 chars); absent = anonymous.

pinned.description: Offline download: the session lives on the pinned TTL and is never throttled.

sourceVersion.description: Version of the source file (rescan counter, mtime): part of the cache key.

startAtS.description: Resume position, seconds on the content timeline.

subtitleRenditions.description:
Master `SUBTITLES` group for clients with `supportsHlsSubtitles`; absent: the embedded
text tracks of `info`.

tags.description: Opaque to the engine, echoed in snapshots (e.g. the host's connection ids).

profileHash.description: Cache profile hash; absent on Direct Play.

clientTonemap.description: HDR copied to an SDR client that tone-maps it itself.

outputContainer.description: `hls` or the source container on Direct Play.

quality.description: `original`, or the pinned rung id, or `auto`.

remuxMasterBandwidthBps.description: BANDWIDTH of the remux variant (DirectStream only).

transcodeBitrateByQuality.description: By rung id; absent on Direct Play.

PlaybackSource.description: The facts of the source the decision was made on.

crop.description: Run `cropdetect` and set `video[0].crop` when bars are significant.

mkvTags.description: Read BCP-47 language tags of a Matroska file with `mkvmerge -J`.

ProbeResult.description:
`ok: false` means ffprobe could not tell (unreadable file, timeout): leave stored rows alone.
`ok: true` with `info.error` is a readable file without streams.

oneOf.description: Present when ok; on failure the empty error blob the host persists today.
Absent when the file is under 128 KiB or unreadable.

QualityEstimate.description: One download quality; `estimatedSize` is in bytes.

ResolveMediaId.description: `mediaId` of a resolve: a media file id, or a live session id (`purpose: live`, M6).

credential.description:
The client credential exactly as received, one of: the `Cookie` header value, the
`Authorization` header value (`Bearer <jwt>`), the bare `?token=` value.

format.description: MIME type of a media file; a subtitle's extension (`srt`, `ass`, `vtt`) or `embedded`.

path.description:
Media file; `sprite.jpg` (`sprite`, may not exist); the subtitle file (external
subtitle) or the media file (embedded subtitle).

ttlS.description: Cache lifetime of this answer; 60 when absent.

SessionExpired.description: 410 body of a data-plane request whose `sid` the engine no longer knows.

quality.description: Last rung served or reported by a heartbeat.

SourceScan.description: Mirrors `SourceScan` (source-scan.ts); `audioConfigChanges` is keyed by audio stream index.

StreamingConfig.description: The `streaming_*` settings, already resolved by the host. Defaults match the host's.

isImageBased.description: Bitmap subtitles (PGS, VOBSUB, DVB) need burn-in.

SubtitleTrack.description: One text subtitle rendition of the master.
